# contentful_app_access_token (Ephemeral Resource)

Exchanges a signed JWT for an app access token scoped to one app installation. The token is valid for ten minutes.

Requests made with this token [act as the installed app](https://www.contentful.com/developers/docs/extensibility/app-framework/app-identity/) in that space and environment. The app can read its own installation, including Secret parameters. Use a management credential with installation permissions to update or uninstall the app. See [how the credential affects imported state](../guides/secrets-and-state#importing-an-installation).

## Publish an Entry as the installed app

Register the public [app key](../resources/app_key) on the app definition and [install the app](../resources/app_installation) in the target environment. This example uses the [Author content type](../resources/content_type#example-usage). Set `default_locale_code` to the environment's default locale for the Author's non-localized `name` field.

The default provider is already configured with a Content Management API access token. It exchanges the app's signed JWT for an app access token. The `editorial` provider uses that token to create and publish the [Entry](../resources/entry).

```terraform
variable "app_private_key" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
  ephemeral = true
}

ephemeral "contentful_app_jwt" "editorial" {
  app_definition_id = var.app_definition_id
  private_key       = var.app_private_key
}

ephemeral "contentful_app_access_token" "editorial" {
  space_id          = var.contentful_space_id
  environment_id    = var.contentful_environment_id
  app_definition_id = var.app_definition_id
  jwt               = ephemeral.contentful_app_jwt.editorial.jwt
}

provider "contentful" {
  alias        = "editorial"
  access_token = ephemeral.contentful_app_access_token.editorial.token
}

resource "contentful_entry" "author" {
  provider        = contentful.editorial
  space_id        = var.contentful_space_id
  environment_id  = var.contentful_environment_id
  content_type_id = "author"

  fields = {
    name = jsonencode({ (var.default_locale_code) = "Ursula Le Guin" })
  }
}
```

Applying a saved plan with this configuration obtains a new app access token. The provider does not renew a token during a long-running operation. Requests made after it expires can return HTTP 401.

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `app_definition_id` (String) ID of the installed app definition.
- `environment_id` (String) ID of the concrete environment where the app is installed.
- `jwt` (String, Sensitive) Signed JWT from [contentful_app_jwt](app_jwt) or another signer that follows [Contentful's JWT requirements](https://www.contentful.com/developers/docs/references/content-management-api/app-access-token/). Use the app definition ID as the issuer and supply the JWT without the Bearer prefix.
- `space_id` (String) ID of the space where the app is installed.

### Read-Only

- `expires_at` (String) Time the app access token expires, in RFC 3339 format.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) App access token issued for this installation.
